استأيكن (form X)
# اِسْتَأْيَكْنَ (istaʔyakna) /is.taʔ.jak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيِكْنَ (istaʔyikna) /is.taʔ.jik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
